title: Residue tensor square on K-flat representatives with K-flat pullback
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-integral-residue-tensor-pull-presentation] and [new-integral-residue-derived-monoidal]. For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, and a proof hFlat that ordinary integral pullback preserves flat objects, let P be an integral homotopy complex on Y such that both P and its ordinary pullback are K-flat. The upper-star image of the canonical restricted-reduction tensor presentation on Y followed by the derived oplax tensor comparison equals restriction/pullback at reduction(Qh P), then restriction of the inverse canonical scalar-extension pull comparison, then the coefficient-adjusted tensor presentation on X. This is only the calculation on the resolving class; no assertion for arbitrary representatives or final tensor-model map is included.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and the tensor-pullback identity in the proof of Lemma 6.5.9(5), p. 50; explicit formal balanced tensor and derived-counit calculation

proof.text: Install the same derived pullback monoidal structure as in the original statement. The ordinary tensor-model target is invertible because the pulled-back representative is K-flat; apply tensorModelTarget_isIso and cancel it on the right.
Apply integralResidue_tensorRoute_model to compute the tensor route after postcomposition with the model target.

Rewrite only the X tensor-pull presentation followed by model target using integralResidue_tensorPullCounit_model. The resulting scalar-counit composite equals the same model map by integralResidue_scalarCounit_model. Reassociation and symmetry give the cancelled equality.

theorem integralResidue_tensorGeometry_component {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hFlat : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.PreservesFlat)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ))
    (hP : (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (hFP : ((f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧).kFlatMap P) :
    letI := residueExchangePullMonoidal ℓ E f
      (residueExchangeOrdinaryPullMonoidal ℓ E f) hFlat
    let M := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P
    (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map
          ((residueExchangeTensorIso ℓ E Y).hom.app M) ≫
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f)
          M (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y) =
      (residueExchangeRestrictPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
            ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y).obj M) ≫
          (residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X).map
            (((residueExchangePullComparisons ℓ E).pull f).inv.app M) ≫
          (residueExchangeTensorPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
            ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M)
